proven: PromptContext carries selected text, raw capture sources and content-free semantic receipts; duplicate capture merges preserve all dependencies and the earliest deadline
Semantic facts remain eligible beyond the 48-hour raw capture deadline under their own automatic/confirmed lifetime; recalling them does not renew that deadline or rehydrate expired raw input
Automatic semantic descendants cannot outlive their parent fact deadline; durable graph edges cascade deletion through descendants and revisioned index cleanup in the same transaction
Lock-free on-loop authority checks validate fact ID/revision/expiry against the sole writer projection; pending revocations deny use before durable commit returns

Tests pause after an actual durable deletion commit before projection publication, and inject commit errors both before and after disk commit; authority follows the real database rather than an assumed rollback
Queued generation retains both historical/summary and recalled fact dependencies, and also rejects cleared or replaced context epochs
Native HTTP generation rechecks source admission after model discovery and before POST; a late or retracted memory snapshot cannot send the stale prompt

Both active voice modes preserve enriched sources through terminal dispatch results and interaction recording; privacy cancellation closes HTTP/body resources and does not emit error speech or stop the queue worker
Legacy fast native inference checks admission before actual worker execution and again after result return; cancelled observation does not abandon the native work or publish its late reply
Short-term memory, context turns/summary/snapshots, transient cache and policy events reject fact-retracted contents before physical index/file cleanup
Repeated cancellation during delivery cleanup keeps the privacy monitor attached until the operation actually exits
The source-free CPython 3.13 runtime exercises fact receipts and deletion of a semantic descendant outside the development checkout
